Toddler meals

Mild white bean stew

Babos zöldség

8 months+ Replaced 35 min 4 portions

Mash any piece that is still whole before you serve it. The beans should crush easily.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 250 g Cooked white beans (Already cooked in plain water until very soft)
  • 200 g Tomato (Chopped)
  • 1 medium Sweet pepper (Seeds removed and chopped)
  • 1 teaspoon Sweet paprika (Mild, not hot)
  • 80 g Sweetcorn (Mash the kernels; do not leave them whole)
  • 150 ml Water (To keep the stew loose)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Put the beans, tomato, pepper, paprika, and water in a pan.
  2. Simmer until the beans crush with no firm core.
  3. Add the sweetcorn and cook for a few minutes more.
  4. Mash the stew so the corn and beans are soft, not whole.
  5. Cool to serving temperature.

Replaced

The usual name was a chili. Hot chili and salt are left out, and whole corn is harder to manage than a mash.

Simmer white beans with tomato, sweet pepper, and sweet paprika until the beans are fully soft, and mash the corn into the stew. Use no hot chili and no salt.
